MM005677-KG.about_this_item: Gemon Mini Adult с курицей и рисом — полнорационный корм для взрослых собак мини-пород: курица как источник незаменимых питательных веществ, рис как источник углеводов, высокая усвояемость благодаря экструзии. Пребиотики FOS и свекольный жом для регулярной работы кишечника, свежее мясо для вкуса, пивные дрожжи для густой мягкой шерсти, юкка Шидигера против кишечных запахов. Без искусственных красителей и консервантов.
MM005677-KG.ingredient_information:
Composition: Cereals (rice 5%), meat and animal derivatives 25% (fresh chicken meat 5%), oils and fats, fish and fish derivatives, derivatives of vegetable origin (beet pulp 2%, fructo-oligosaccharides FOS 1% and yucca schidigera 0.1%), yeasts (brewer’s yeast 1%), minerals.

Analytical constituents: Crude Protein: 26%, Crude Fibre: 2.8%, Crude Fat: 13%, Crude Ash: 7.0%, Calcium: 1.6%, Phosphorus 1.1%. Metabolized Energy: 3,940kcal/kg.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES/kg: Vitamin A (Retinyl Acetate) 27,700 IU, Vitamin D3 1,450 IU, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl acetate) 65 mg, Choline chloride 1,000 mg, Selenium (Sodium selenite 0.33 mg) 0.15 mg,Manganese (manganous sulphate monohydrate 69 mg) 22.5 mg, Zinc (Zinc oxide 130 mg) 105 mg, Copper (Copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 35mg) 9 mg, Iron (Iron (II) sulphate monohydrate 228mg) 75 mg, Iodine (Calcium iodate anhydrous 1.8mg) 1.2 mg. TECHNOLOGICAL ADDITIVES: Antioxidants. SENSORY ADDITIVES: Chestnut extract 20 mg/ kg.
MM005677-KG.feeding_instructions: Recommended daily feeding intakes (see table) may be split into 2 daily meals. Individual nutritional requirements may vary due to size, age and activity level of the animal. Fresh and clean water should be available at all times. When this product replaces another type of feed and/or diet it is recommended to introduce it gradually over a period of at least 1 week. Dog food only, not suitable for human consumption.
